subject.title: macOS launchd: plugin/config maintenance can leave Control UI in broken partial-reload state; restart may require doctor --fix

question: What shared degraded-state contract should Gateway expose during partial reload/restart windows, and should `sessions.resolve` return retryable readiness errors instead of `No session found` while that contract is active?
rationale: The source shows useful partial mitigations, but the remaining fix crosses Gateway readiness, session RPCs, restart recovery, and Control UI UX, so automation should not choose the product contract alone.

options.title: Define Shared Reload Readiness Contract
options.body: Add one Gateway partial-reload/degraded-state model consumed by Control UI and session RPCs, with live macOS launchd proof.

options.title: Land Narrow WebChat Notice First
options.body: Use the open WebChat notice PR for the blank-chat subset and keep this issue open for the broader readiness/reload contract.

options.title: Accept Current Operator Recovery
options.body: Treat current `/readyz`, restart deferral, stale PID cleanup, and doctor recovery paths as sufficient and close only by explicit maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Reload Readiness Contract
recommendation.body: Add one Gateway partial-reload/degraded-state model consumed by Control UI and session RPCs, with live macOS launchd proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are connected to both readiness and Control UI startup hydration history, making them a plausible owner for the cross-surface contract decision.
